newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India firm as local markets holidays.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India firm as local markets holidays.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts (GDRs) were firm in thin trade as the Bombay Stock Exchange took a holiday.
"The National exchange was open but London took the chance to have a breather. No one is buying in any case," said a trader.
The James Capel Indian GDR index closed up 0.52 points, 0.70 percent, at 73.83 points, with the premium over the local market at 13.38 percent.

Investors are waiting for firm news on whether a $600-$800 million GDR offering for India's overseas telephone monopoly will take place and looking at a $400 million offering for State Bank of India, which will roadshow in London in the week of September 23.
Taiwanese GDRs were subdued, up just 0.37 points at 90.01, a premium of 4.42 percent after the Taiwan Weighted Index rose 76.18 points or 1.22 percent at 6,304.96.
The Capel Korea Index fell 1.68 points, 2.39 percent, to 68.64, a premium of 23.58 percent, after the Korea Composite Index closed 4.50 points lower at a provisional 787.14.
